description: Compute basal/resting metabolic rate — the calories your body burns at rest. Returns the headline Mifflin-St Jeor (1990) value plus the revised Harris-Benedict (Roza & Shizgal 1984) estimate for comparison. Needs age, sex, height and weight. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

sex.description: Biological sex — drives the energy equation.

name: calculate_bmr
title: Calculate basal metabolic rate (BMR)
